purpose: Preserve verified, resolved, ambiguous and testimony-only military/ocean acoustic anomalies before applying the Janus transformed-echo reverse operator.

cases.reported_observation: Retired Rear Admiral Tim Gallaudet stated that submarine witnesses told him of sonar data from a nuclear-powered ballistic-missile submarine. The reported contact had a Russian-torpedo-like speed/closing rate, slowed and followed in the submarine wake for minutes, then rapidly exited.
cases.hard_boundary: Gallaudet explicitly said he had no personal submersible-object experience; this is witness testimony about sonar data, not the raw track.

cases.reported_observation: Early sonar/echo-sounding operators observed an apparent second seafloor whose depth changed between day and night.
cases.resolved_source: Deep scattering layer of marine organisms; swim bladders and dense organism layers strongly reflect sound and undergo diel vertical migration.

cases.reported_observation: Highly repetitive mechanical-sounding underwater pulse series recorded widely in the Southern Ocean.
cases.resolved_source: Antarctic minke whale Balaenoptera bonaerensis, established with multi-sensor acoustic tags on whales.

cases.reported_observation: Later Soviet/Russian submarine recollections describe recurring quacking contacts, sometimes described as changing with submarine approach or active acoustic transmissions.
cases.competing_military_interpretation: A published naval recollection by Rear Admiral Vladlen Naumov interprets at least some 'quacker' episodes as active airborne radio-hydroacoustic sonobuoys used in ASW interaction with SOSUS and patrol aviation.
cases.hard_boundary: No raw hydroacoustic recording, navigation solution or complete event denominator recovered in this pass.
